decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - Details of any new openings for services, water and waste disposal and ventilation to include materials, at 1:20 scale, shall be submitted by the consent holder to the Local Planning Authority and approved before the commencement of works.

Condition : 5 - Any areas of external brickwork required to be re-instated in accordance with the approved plans shall match the existing brickwork in brick colour and size, mortar colour and pointing and bonding detail.
Condition : 6 - The roof tiles should be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 4 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 7 - Details of external brickwork, pointing, mortar, and bonding shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects. The existing chimney pots shall be retained and re-instated on the chimney.

Condition : 8 - The works hereby granted shall be monitored and inspected on a regular basis by the architect. The architect shall undertake a final inspection and provide a copy of the final report to the Local Planning Authority. The final report shall be provided within three months of the completion of works.

Condition : 9 - The tiled surround to Fireplace 1, 3 and 4 shall be reinstated within six months of the granting of this permission. Fireplace 3 shall have the tiled surround reinstated with the geometric dotted tiles originally removed from the dwelling and as shown in the Design and Access statement provided with the application. Fireplaces 1 and 4 shall have tiles reinstated using William De Morgan floral tiles from the De Morgan centre or another tile as approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, all due care shall be taken in dismantling the stone steps at the front and rear of the dwelling. Any slab with only one break shall be repaired, rather than replaced.

Condition : 11 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, unless otherwise specified in the application hereby approved.
description: Listed building consent to undertake internal repairs and alterations to fireplaces and bathrooms, new timber floors over existing, and the construction of a new door opening. External repairs to the roof, brickwork, re-pointing of the gable, rebuilding of the chimney, lead weathering, external pipe work, windows, relocation of flue, and alterations to the front and rear steps.
